notes.source: The floating back control every secondary page wears (#967). `frontend/ui/shared/back-button.tsx` is the reference: one word, announced by the control and drawn nowhere else, so the app's copy of it comes from this source rather than being typed into Kotlin (ADR-0098).
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails the label if the reference component stops rendering it.
